subject: Capstone briefs & evidence rollup for upcoming executive review
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Executive review — short evidence pack request
Attachments: none

Hi Naomi / Vivek,

Thanks for the continued partnership this quarter. Our execs asked for a short bundle (one page per strategic theme) showing outcomes tied to the program we run with Redwood ahead of next week's leadership review. High level ask: 3 slides/one-pagers that include
- the objective and one metric we tracked
- outcome vs target (brief)
- one line on follow-up action or ask from Acme

Can you send something crisper than the full spreadsheet — we want to surface wins + the honest signals (what missed & why). Ideally by Friday EOD so our CEO can fold it into the review deck.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Carter
Head of Partnerships, Acme Analytics

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive review — short evidence pack request
Cc: Emily Carter <emily@acmeanalytics.com>
Attachments: capstone_briefs_v1.docx (draft), EOQ_evidence_index.csv

Team — looping you in. Emily needs a lean "executive pack" for their leadership review by Friday. I put together a first draft (attached) and an index CSV that maps evidence rows to each one-pager. Quick plan:

1) Vivek — can you confirm the prioritized metric per theme (I guessed TP95 latency for developer UX, revenue acceleration for pricing experiments, and retention delta for the pilot)?
2) Laura — can you take the "narratives" doc and pare each down to a 1–2 sentence hook + 1 supporting datapoint? Use the snippets template I added.
3) Monica — can you pull the audit log snippets + one example trace for the latency theme (we need an example that shows before/after cache tuning)?

Deliverables by EOD Thu so I can stitch and send to Emily Fri morning PST.

Notes on tone: keep it candid — include a short line under each slide saying "open risk" if we have ongoing rollouts. Emily explicitly asked for wins + honest signals.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive review — short evidence pack request
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Attachments: none

Thanks Naomi — quick confirmations below:
- Developer UX theme: TP95 latency is the right signal (use median + TP95 callouts).
- Pricing experiments: use net-new ARR influence and conversion delta (Nov 15–Dec 5 window).
- Retention pilot: retention lift vs matched cohort; call out confidence intervals.

Two quick edits to the draft:
- In the "wins" slide, lead with the customer-visible metric (latency improvement) before internal infra metrics. Execs care about product impact.
- In the "risks" line, quantify potential impact where possible (e.g., "cache desync affected ~3% of traffic, ~1.2% revenue exposure").

I'll flag the model-variant fallback note in the narrative — keep it one sentence.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product Officer | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive review — short evidence pack request
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Emily Carter <emily@acmeanalytics.com>
Attachments: narrative_snippets_v2.docx, okr_heatmap_DEC2026.png

Adding the pared narratives and the heatmap visual. I kept each hook to <= 20 words and added a one-line context sentence and a single datapoint. Example for latency theme:

- Hook: "TP95 latency improved 38% after KV cache calibration — user-facing calls returned more consistently."
- Context: "Cache calibration deployed Nov 20; observed across 6 services; rollback threshold not reached."
- Datapoint: "TP95: 540ms -> 335ms (Nov 1 vs Dec 6)."

I've also annotated where we don't have clean instrumentation and suggested a follow-up analytics ticket where needed. Monica — the audit snippets you pull should match the rows in EOQ_evidence_index.csv (I flagged row IDs 14–18).

Small note on tone: Emily asked for wins + honest signals, not long technical troubleshooting logs. Keep the audit sample 2–3 lines and link to full logs in the Drive.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Insights & Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: Capstone briefs & evidence rollup for your executive review (final)
Attachments: capstone_briefs_v1.docx, EOQ_evidence_index.csv, narrative_snippets_v2.docx, okr_heatmap_DEC2026.png

Hi Emily — attaching the concise pack for your leadership review. Deliverables included: 
- 3 one-pagers (developer UX, pricing experiments, retention pilot) — file: capstone_briefs_v1.docx
- Evidence index mapping to raw artifacts — file: EOQ_evidence_index.csv
- Narrative snippets (short hooks + datapoints) — file: narrative_snippets_v2.docx
- Quick heatmap visual of OKR signals — file: okr_heatmap_DEC2026.png

Quick summary of the signal set:
- Developer UX: TP95 latency down 38% after cache tuning; identified a remaining 3% desync exposure (mitigation in flight).
- Pricing: two experiments show +4.3% conversion lift in narrow cohort; recommend expanding test groups before wider rollout.
- Retention pilot: preliminary lift of +2.1 p.p. at 30 days vs matched cohort (low sample; next step is extended window).

If you'd like, we can convert these pages into two slides and drop them into your deck; tell me whether you prefer red/green KPI tiles vs left-aligned narrative.

Thanks for the clarity on what you needed — happy to iterate if your execs want a tighter single-slide summary.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments manifest:
- capstone_briefs_v1.docx (3 one-pagers, 1 page per theme)
- EOQ_evidence_index.csv (row IDs referenced across documents)
- narrative_snippets_v2.docx (short hooks + datapoints)
- okr_heatmap_DEC2026.png (visual; 1200x600)
